3.title: Compatibility tests of absorbance indicators in chemolithoautotrophic acidophile media.
3.note: Added Fe₂(SO₄)₃ concentrations exclude the Fe already present in the medium. Measured pH values describe medium–standard mixtures before dye addition. Medium-component concentrations refer to the standard medium before dye addition. All measurements were abiotic six-wavelength absorbance measurements in non-UV-transparent microplates without lids.

AFM-01: AFM1 and AFM3 with 0–5.2×10⁻² M added Fe₂(SO₄)₃, without dye (8 [Fe₂(SO₄)₃] × 2 media)
AFM1 and AFM3 occupy separate well groups on the same plates
F2S-01: Compatibility: ratiometric pH and Fe³⁺ indicators

F2S with 0–5.2×10⁻² M added Fe₂(SO₄)₃, without dye (8 [Fe₂(SO₄)₃])
F2S supplemented with H₂SO₄, spanning measured pH 0.7–2.1, with and without 10⁻⁵ M thymol blue (8 [H₂SO₄] × 2 [dye])
Fe₂(SO₄)₃ and H₂SO₄ standard series occupy separate well groups on the same plates
Starkey-01: Starkey (St) medium with brown or yellow S⁰, supplemented with H₂SO₄, spanning measured pH 0.7–2.8 for each medium, with and without 10⁻⁵ M thymol blue (8 [H₂SO₄] × 2 S⁰ types × 2 [dye])
Both S⁰ types occupy separate well groups on the same plates
9K-01: AFM4 or AFM5 supplemented with H₂SO₄, spanning measured pH 0.7–3.8 for each medium, with and without 10⁻⁵ M thymol blue (8 [H₂SO₄] × 2 media × 2 [dye])
AFM4 and AFM5 occupy separate well groups on the same plates

4.title: Demonstration tests in acidophile microplate cultures.
4.note: The six experiment groups comprise independently inoculated microplates (n_microplate=438 in total). A₃₈₀ indicates apparent formation of the metabolic byproduct Fe³⁺ in cultures supplied with Fe²⁺. Measured R and scatter-corrected R* indicate acidification associated with metabolic H+ release in soluble-S cultures, as defined in Data processing. Additive concentrations use the deposited compound basis, except explicitly specified elemental-Ga concentrations in citric-acid/Ga₂(SO₄)₃ combinations.
